scope: Candidate texture and physical-behavior envelopes for deterministic compatibility screening. Values are not laboratory results, field classifications, engineering design values or agronomic guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines a coarse-textured sandy simulation analog while retaining uncertainty.
numeric_parameters.risk: A candidate fraction cannot replace a particle-size laboratory analysis.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the proposed sandy mineral texture partition.
numeric_parameters.risk: Field texture may differ materially from this bounded analog.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the proposed sandy mineral texture partition.
numeric_parameters.risk: Small clay changes can alter retention and loading behavior.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a screening envelope for a mineral sandy analog independent of compaction state.
numeric_parameters.risk: Bulk density is site and management dependent and requires measurement.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a coarse-texture porosity envelope for simulation screening.
numeric_parameters.risk: Porosity cannot be inferred from texture alone.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a rapid-drainage simulation envelope for deterministic water routing.
numeric_parameters.risk: Preferential flow, layering and compaction can invalidate this range.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a bounded erosion-sensitivity input without changing soil mass directly.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index is not a laboratory aggregate-stability result.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the coarse component of the sandy-loam simulation analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: A proposed texture envelope is not a field classification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the sandy-loam texture partition with a moderate fine fraction.
numeric_parameters.risk: The candidate class may overlap other real texture systems.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the sandy-loam texture partition.
numeric_parameters.risk: Clay mineralogy is not represented by a fraction alone.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a mineral sandy-loam screening envelope independent of loading history.
numeric_parameters.risk: Compaction and organic matter can move the measured value outside this range.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a bounded sandy-loam pore-space input.
numeric_parameters.risk: Texture does not uniquely determine pore connectivity.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a moderately rapid candidate drainage envelope.
numeric_parameters.risk: Layering, crusting and compaction require separate state inputs.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a candidate structural-stability input for erosion flow tests.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index must not be treated as a measured erosion-control rating.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the coarse component of a balanced loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: The envelope is a simulation convenience rather than a survey classification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the medium-size component of a balanced loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Particle-size boundaries are not established by this package.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the balanced loam texture partition.
numeric_parameters.risk: Clay activity and shrink-swell behavior remain unmodeled.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a loam screening envelope separate from the current compaction state.
numeric_parameters.risk: Management and horizon differences can dominate the type-level estimate.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a balanced pore-space envelope for simulation.
numeric_parameters.risk: Porosity and effective porosity are not interchangeable.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a moderate candidate drainage envelope.
numeric_parameters.risk: Preferential flow can produce behavior outside the range.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a bounded structure input for erosion and restoration scenarios.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index is not a measured soil-health score.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the coarse component of a silt-dominant analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: A candidate texture does not identify depositional history.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the dominant component of the silt-loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Silt-rich surfaces may crust or erode independently of this fraction.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the silt-loam mineral texture partition.
numeric_parameters.risk: Clay mineralogy and structure remain unresolved.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a silt-loam density screening envelope independent of compaction.
numeric_parameters.risk: Wetness and traffic can substantially change measured density.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a silt-loam pore-space envelope for screening.
numeric_parameters.risk: Pore connectivity and surface sealing remain separate variables.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a moderate-to-slow candidate drainage envelope.
numeric_parameters.risk: Surface crusting can lower infiltration below the proposed range.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Supports deterministic erosion sensitivity without modifying composition.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index is not an erosion permit or soil-health certification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the coarse component of a clay-loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Texture alone cannot identify structural behavior.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the medium-size component of a clay-loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Real horizon mixtures may not match the proposed partition.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the fine component of a clay-loam analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Clay activity and shrink-swell behavior require separate validation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a clay-loam density envelope separate from compaction history.
numeric_parameters.risk: Loading, drainage and structure can dominate measured density.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a fine-texture pore-space envelope for screening.
numeric_parameters.risk: High total porosity does not imply rapid drainage.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a slow candidate drainage envelope for clay loam.
numeric_parameters.risk: Cracks and macropores can create bypass flow outside this range.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a bounded structure input while erosion remains a separate mass flow.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index cannot establish erosion safety or trafficability.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the coarse component of a clay-dominant analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proposed fraction is not a site classification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the non-clay portion of the clay analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Silt and clay boundaries require laboratory methods not supplied here.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the dominant fine component of the clay analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Mineralogy, cracking and shrink-swell potential remain unresolved.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a clay density screening envelope independent of moisture and loading.
numeric_parameters.risk: Moisture and compaction can strongly alter in-place behavior.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a clay pore-space envelope while keeping permeability separate.
numeric_parameters.risk: Total porosity does not establish usable water or foundation performance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a very slow matrix-flow candidate envelope.
numeric_parameters.risk: Desiccation cracks may create rapid preferential flow not captured here.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a bounded structure input distinct from shrink-swell and erosion states.
numeric_parameters.risk: The index does not certify stability under wetting or loading.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines only the mineral fraction of the organic-rich mineral analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: Organic material is deliberately excluded from this mineral partition.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Defines the medium-size mineral component separately from organic matter.
numeric_parameters.risk: The analog is not a peat or organic-soil classification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Completes the mineral texture partition while organic matter remains a separate pool.
numeric_parameters.risk: Mineral texture cannot establish organic horizon behavior.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a low-density screening envelope associated with a separately sourced organic pool.
numeric_parameters.risk: Decomposition, saturation and compaction can alter density substantially.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Proposes a high-porosity screening envelope for an organic-rich mineral analog.
numeric_parameters.risk: High porosity may accompany high compressibility and does not imply foundation support.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Represents a broad variable-flow envelope for deterministic screening.
numeric_parameters.risk: Decomposition, layering and saturation can reverse expected drainage behavior.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a candidate surface-structure input while organic mass is conserved separately.
numeric_parameters.risk: Organic aggregation does not establish long-term structural or loading stability.
